name: oods-price-badge
title: OODS Foundry PriceBadge
description: React adapter for OODS PriceBadge on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Preserves amount and currency precedence, currency minor units, label/children/value fallback and emphasis. Binding metadata props field, amountField, currencyField, intervalField and minorUnitsParameter retain the OODS no-op behavior.
